scenes.say: Pedro Acosta won Moto3 at seventeen, in his very first season. Here's the ladder he climbed.
Talent Cup from age fourteen, Rookies from fifteen, the world championship only from eighteen.
It starts on minibikes, then the national Talent Cups. You can join those at fourteen.
Next is the Red Bull Rookies Cup or JuniorGP. The top three can step up to Moto3 at seventeen.
Moto3 has one cylinder and sixty horsepower. Moto2 runs a Triumph triple with a hundred thirty-eight.
MotoGP bikes make over two hundred fifty. Acosta got there in twenty twenty-four, after winning Moto2.
All three MotoGP classes are on LapRadar.

title: The road to MotoGP: Talent Cup, Rookies Cup, Moto3, Moto2
